lines.text: Somebody's filing a report on this.
That's coming out of somebody's pay.
Vipers. Always the Vipers.
I've dealt with worse before breakfast.
Frak, that's gonna leave a mark.
Gods-frakking-damnit, Starbuck!
Frakking hell, Starbuck, watch your six!
That was avoidable, Kara. Frakking avoidable.
Thirty-three seconds isn't a nap. Move.
Paperwork doesn't file itself. Move it.
Thirty-three seconds. Not a coffee break.
This job needs a stiff drink. Later.
The Old Man says move. So move.
Starbuck, if you break another wing I swear to the gods—
Frakking patience, Thrace. That's all I ask.
Hull's thin. Watch yourself out there.
We're running low on ship. Land it careful.
Damage control's stretched thin. Don't test it.
Hull integrity's dropping. I don't like the numbers.
We're patched together with hope at this point.
Starbuck, ease up before you gods-damned kill us.
Frak me, this hull's had enough of your stunts, Starbuck.
You planning on shooting something today, Starbuck?
Frak, are they hiding from you now?
That's a long dry spell up there.
Something wrong with the trigger, Lieutenant?
Kids these days can't hit the broad side of a Battlestar.
Who in the frak are you talking to?
That did it. Starbuck finally lost it.
You feeling alright up there?
